Nina (Finance Ops): QuotaPilot sent a renewal/upgrade proposal. It mixes committed tokens + overage. Can procurement/eng/legal take a quick look? I want a recommendation before we start renewal negotiations.
Aaron (Procurement): Thanks — putting it here. Main asks: 1) seat vs usage impact at our baseline, 2) how migration credit works, 3) SLA/penalties, 4) technical metering (webhook/schema). Can someone paste the baseline tokens we should assume?
Lucas (Backend): For the last quarter our 95th pct usage is ~720M tokens/mo, avg ~460M. Rough per-request: median 380 tokens, mean ~450. If we commit I want per-request attribution so we can map to routes. :thinking:
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Hi all — quick summary from our side. Offer highlights: commit tiers (200M / 600M / 1B tokens), committed pricing examples: 200M = $1,200/mo, 600M = $3,000/mo, 1B = $4,800/mo. Pay-as-you-go: $0.007 per 1k tokens. Migration credit: up to 20% of first-year committed spend for 12mo commits (applied as monthly credits). SLA: 99.9% for Enterprise tier, 99.5% on committed. Overages: billed monthly at payg rate with option for discounted overage (10% off) when on an active commit. I'll paste a quick projection.
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): ```
# projection example
baseline = 600_000_000  # tokens/mo (approx Q4 2025 95th)
payg = baseline/1000 * 0.007    # $4,200/mo
commit_600 = 3000               # $3,000/mo -> effective ~$0.005/token
savings = payg - commit_600     # ~$1,200/mo
```
Aaron (Procurement): That helps. Can you confirm annualized delta (including migration credit) and whether the commit can be annual prepay vs monthly billing? Also we need cancellation windows and termination fees.
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Annual options available: annual prepay gets additional 8% discount. Example: 600M prepaid annual = $32,400/year vs monthly $36,000. Migration credit applied over first 12 months as monthly credits. Cancellation: 60-day notice for non-renewal; no refunds on prepaid unless Enterprise addendum signed (custom carve-outs possible).
Lucas (Backend): Metering question — do you support per-request attribution (route/service tags) and a webhook for usage events? We need event sample to validate our billing pipeline.
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Yes, per-request metadata supported. Sample webhook payload below: ```
POST /webhooks/usage HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "customer_id": "rw-12345",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-02T16:23:45Z",
  "tokens": 1240,
  "route": "/api/v1/generate",
  "request_id": "req_9a8b7c",
  "model": "open-llama-13b"
}
```
And a quick curl to fetch monthly usage summary: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" 
  "https://api.quotapilot.io/v1/billing/usage?customer=rw-12345&month=2025-11"
```
Anya (Legal): From legal side: need default data retention for raw logs, whether they delete on termination, and DPA / data controls (encryption, subprocessor list). Also want termination penalties spelled out — nothing that auto-renews without explicit 30-day notice.
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Legal: standard retention is 90 days for raw request payloads, aggregated metrics retained 7 years for billing reconciliation. For Enterprise we can extend raw logs retention or provide on-prem options. We offer a DPA + SOC 2 report; we can add a contract clause for 30-day opt-out on auto-renewal and clear termination T&Cs in the quote.
Aaron (Procurement): Good. Two follow-ups: - Can you provide an itemized SKU list (commit tiers, overage SKU, premium support SKU, SLA add-on SKU)? - Can we get a sample invoice and a Net30 PO-friendly billing flow?
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): I'll send an itemized quote + sample invoice PDF. SKU mapping example in the quote: COMMIT_600, OVR_PAYG, SUPPORT_PLUS. Invoices support Net30 for Enterprise (billing contact + PO #).
Nina (Finance Ops): If numbers above hold, switching from pure PAYG -> 600M commit saves ~1.2k/mo. But we need annualized cashflow view. Aaron — can you run a quick TCO (3-year) with annual prepay vs monthly?
Aaron (Procurement): Will do. Planning sync: can we schedule 30m with Lina next Tue? @Lina can you do Tue 10am PT? :calendar:
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Tue 10am PT works. I'll send calendar invite + formal quote by end of day Friday.
Nina (Finance Ops): Great — please include explicit overage math, credit application schedule, and the exact webhook schema so eng can validate. :thumbsup:
Lucas (Backend): I'll run a quick ingestion test once webhook schema arrives.
Anya (Legal): Please include DPA + SOC2 snapshot in the packet.
Aaron (Procurement): I'll draft a short PO template and share to this thread once I have Lina's final quote. Lina — can you confirm quote by EOD Fri? :invoice:
Lina (QuotaPilot Sales): Confirmed — final quote, SKU list, sample invoice, DPA and webhook doc by EOD Fri. Thanks all.
Nina (Finance Ops): Thanks team, closing loop once we have the formal quote and PO.
